verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway offers built-in policies (Prompt Guard, content-safety/DLP, rate limiting, guardrails) that automatically act when certain request conditions occur, which is a narrow form of rule-triggered automation, but there's no evidence of a general user-defined rules/event engine (custom triggers + custom actions) as implied by the story. Missing for 10: a generic event-condition-action rule builder, evidence of arbitrary custom triggers/actions beyond fixed policy types, and any user-hands-on confirmation of custom automation workflows.
